chunks.text: Google will test AI data center racks in orbit. It booked a Blue Origin New Glenn launch for the first quarter of 2029. Project Suncatcher uses solar-powered satellites carrying Google's Tensor Processing Units. The goal: test AI workloads at roughly single-rack scale. IDC's Dave McCarthy says no technician can swap a failed GPU at 500 kilometers. Data Center Knowledge reports heat rejection is the biggest engineering obstacle. Would Gulf data center operators ever look to space for compute?
